blocks.x: Intelligent Process Automation at Scale in production terms — the runtime that holds it, the policies that bound it, the dashboards that prove it, and the quarterly delta your finance team can bank.
The problem this solution exists for
RPA estates fragment across kingdoms; agents arrive ungoverned; nobody knows which automation did what; conformance drifts.
Our approach
We mine the process truth first, build the automation spine (events, APIs, RPA, agents under one control plane), stage rollouts with replay evaluation, and keep conformance measured quarterly.

blocks.x: Prerequisites and data readiness

Before Intelligent Process Automation at Scale starts, three things need to exist: a metric your board recognizes, data access under an approved path, and a named owner on each source system. The readiness check takes two weeks and says no when it should.
How a delivery runs

We run Intelligent Process Automation at Scale in gates: each one reviews measured deltas against the signed baseline with your named owners in the room, and each one can stop the program. That is the discipline most enterprise programs are missing.
